name: WF2e TikTok Scheduled Report Email Import (Raw Only)

filters.q: is:unread has:attachment newer_than:30d {filename:csv filename:xlsx filename:xls filename:xlsm}

nodes.name: Find unread TikTok report emails
nodes.notes: Searches all senders for unread spreadsheet attachments. Keep is:unread to prevent the same email being imported on every poll.

nodes.name: Extract TikTok report attachments
nodes.notes: Accepts spreadsheet attachments from any sender. Brand matching and TikTok-column normalization happen in the next Code node.

nodes.name: Keep email metadata with each parsed row
Normalize TikTok rows to raw-sheet headers
nodes.notes: The target tabs and headers are fixed by the existing Raw Data template. Edit aliases above if your TikTok export uses different names.

parameters.subject: TikTok report import needs review
parameters.message:
={{ 'The TikTok email was not imported.

Reason: ' + ($json.error || 'unknown') + '
Subject: ' + ($json.subject || '') + '
File: ' + ($json.fileName || '') + '

Update the aliases/brand match in Normalize TikTok rows to raw-sheet headers, then mark the email unread and run again.' }}

nodes.name: Alert on unmatched TikTok report
nodes.notes: Optional failure alert. Replace the recipient placeholder with a real address and configure SMTP, or disable/remove this node. It intentionally does not use $env so it works with n8n environment-variable restrictions.

nodes.name: Mark imported emails as read
nodes.notes: Remove or disable this node if you want to keep report emails unread after import.
